title: rolling storage bins
text: rolling storage bins. They come fully assembled.  The wheels are tiny - and I did have to pop one wheel back into place, but that is no biggee.  I was worried the tiny wheels wouldn't roll that well, but they do.  I purchased 4 and used them under my kitchen sink.  Work perfectly - even when and most importantly, when loaded. And there is NOTHING to rust.  Win/Win.  They are a mostly clear plastic, handles are black and wheels are black - all plastic. If I need them, I would buy them again. product_metadata.title: Plastic Storage Bin with Black Handle and Rolling Wheels for Kitchen, Pantry, Craft, Office or Toy Organization
features: Add extra storage space to your cabinets and cupboards while simultaneously making it easier to utilize with this storage bin that has wheels. Slide it in and out of shelf spaces.
Place it in the bathroom, kitchen, or on a shelf in the garage. For those with children learning from home and working from home, use this plastic wheel bin to store school supplies.
Because this storage bin has roll wheels, you can use it in the bathroom or in the kitchen when you need to save on space. Make use of those tight spots throughout the home.
Keep this rolling wheel storage bin for your own home or give it as a gift to family and friends who could use more storage space within their homes.
